info.title: Ronin Control Plane API
info.description: Strict alpha /v1 contract. Response objects and semantic enums are closed; error-code values are open within the normalized error envelope. Static bearer credentials are bound server-side to typed project grants. See docs/product/API_COMPATIBILITY_V1.md and docs/product/AUTHORIZATION_GRANTS_V1.md.

bearerAuth.description: Static v0.1 bearer credential. The server binds the credential to a typed GrantSet; operation requirements are documented by x-ronin-required-project-actions. Direct job routes return 404 when the job is outside the credential's project authority.

SqlWireScalar.description: JSON-safe SQL scalar. UTC timestamps use RFC 3339 with a Z suffix; decimal and UUID values are strings; binary values are standard Base64.

code.description: Open error-code vocabulary; HTTP status remains authoritative.
